title: Waterford River Valley Campground

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: Our Mission Statement: to provide an enjoyable urban camping experience to guests amidst a natural legacy, while protecting Canada’s biodiversity and the wonder of Newfoundland and Labrador’s natural way of life. Welcome to the Waterford River Valley Campgrounds. Our campground is newly established and will continue to expand through the summer and fall of 2019. We are currently in Phase One of at least three stages of constructing and preserving this camping oasis in Mount Pearl. We are a family-oriented park and the following rules will ensure that all guests have a relaxing and enjoyable stay. Please review our rules and help make everyone’s stay a rewarding experience!
